lead.t: Skin lesions — papules resembling molluscum contagiosum
lead.s: Medical Mycology Q&A Section A — MCQ Bank

b: Common skin infection — especially in children and immunocompromised
Transmitted by direct contact and fomites
Lesions: Small, pearly, dome-shaped papules with central umbilication — pathognomonic
Self-limiting in immunocompetent — resolves in months
